title: [human] Land ccp-receiver-aware decision entry in decisions.jsonl (or amend 02b citation)
description: From x7hh.13.1.1 verification (worker6, 2026-09-09). spec/02b-ccp-receiver-aware.md:9 states 'The ccp-receiver-aware decision in decisions.jsonl supersedes the older density-driven channel/SF policy', but decisions.jsonl has NO ccp-receiver-aware entry. Confirmed absent from every working tree and every commit across all worker checkouts and the shared workspace checkout (git log --all -S, pickaxe over decisions.jsonl paths: zero hits). The entry's accepted text is unrecoverable from available artifacts, so it was NOT invented. Both docs also cite publication bead project-LICHEN-worker6-q74u, which is absent from the store (x7hh.13.1.1 rules: absent historical publication bead is not a record to recreate). Decision needed from Mark: (a) supply the accepted ccp-receiver-aware entry in the standard schema (id/decided/by/specs/subject/decision/old_value/rationale/verify — it supersedes the density-driven channel/SF consequences of density-high while retaining its >10 adaptive-tier boundary, per 02b CCP2-001) and land it in spec/decisions.jsonl, or (b) adjudicate that 02b-ccp-receiver-aware.md standalone is the publication of record and amend its line 9 citation to stop asserting a decisions.jsonl entry. Until then 02b's decision-file citation does not resolve; the doc text itself was recovered and committed verbatim (sha256 02b: c69dd66a6e76ee41363a12b745a1e8ccc4f5b95ae629675dfbd6b706ba98ba90, conformance: f24065bc1f0b846277f676986707260508c78551471d9f30d41d26330d002d1b) in this round.
